children: Captain Philips – “Look at me. I am the captain now.”

The line is appropriated and turned back on the pirate. “Who’s the Jolly Roger now?” shifts the balance of power, using the language and mythology of piracy to communicate protection without having to explain it literally.

It gives MUSO a voice that is confident, knowing and slightly provocative — transforming what could otherwise be a technical conversation about anti-piracy into something immediate, culturally recognisable and memorable.
